name: Equipment Issues
definition: Customer requests related to returned, rented, reset, malfunctioning, or incorrectly installed equipment such as set‑top boxes, routers, gateways, or modems, including removal or return.

name: Service Outage
definition: Customer reports loss or interruption of TV, internet, or cable service, including widespread or localized outages and requests for status updates.

name: Streaming Content Issues
definition: Customer cannot access on‑demand, streaming apps, or specific content, including missing episodes, licensing restrictions, or live streaming app access.

name: Channel Issues
definition: Customer cannot view a channel, has problems with channel lineup, HD quality, or package changes, including cable TV or streaming issues.

name: Internet Performance
definition: Customer reports slow, inconsistent, or unreliable internet speeds, connectivity drops, data throttling, data caps, or locked‑out Wi‑Fi.

name: Billing Issues
definition: Customer disputes charges, requests refunds or credits, or has billing errors, including late fees, payment status concerns, rate disputes, price increases, or hidden fees.

name: Account Management
definition: Customer requests account status, billing, contact info, login assistance, changes to services, or login/account access issues.

name: Technical Support
definition: Customer needs help troubleshooting equipment, error codes, signal quality, Wi‑Fi, speed, device configuration, VPN/security queries, or general technical issues.

name: Service Availability & Scheduling
definition: Customer asks if service is available in a specific location, requests new service activation, move, or activation, and wants to schedule, reschedule, or discuss a technician visit for repair or installation.

name: Escalation & Security
definition: Customer requests a supervisor or higher‑level assistance, includes harassment/rude language, retention offers, lack of response, or alleges unauthorized access, data breaches, or fraudulent activity and requests protection or investigation.
